cues: Brace before you unrack, not after.
Knees track over the toes.
Descend until the hip crease passes the knee if you can hold position.
back-squat.mistake: Letting the chest drop faster than the hips out of the bottom.

cues: Hold the bell tight to the chest.
Elbows travel inside the knees.
Keep the torso tall the whole way down.
goblet-squat.mistake: Letting the bell drift away from the body.

cues: Sit between the hips, not straight down.
Keep full-foot pressure.
Stand tall without locking hard.
Push the hips back before the bar moves.
Keep the bar in contact with the thighs.
Stop when the hamstrings stop lengthening.
romanian-deadlift.mistake: Turning it into a squat by bending the knees early.

cues: Squeeze the glutes so the ribs stay down.
Move the head back, then through, as the bar clears.
Finish with the bar over the mid-foot.
overhead-press.mistake: Leaning back to make the lockout instead of pressing.

cues: Hands under the shoulders.
Hold one line from ear to ankle.
Lower under control to a consistent depth.
push-up.mistake: Hips sagging before the chest arrives.

cues: Start from a full hang.
Pull the elbows down toward the ribs.
Control the descent instead of dropping.
pull-up.mistake: Kipping the hips to finish the rep.

cues: Set the shoulder blades down and back.
Keep the forearms vertical at the bottom.
Drive the feet into the floor.
bench-press.mistake: Bouncing the bar off the chest.

cues: Hinge until the torso is near parallel.
Pull to the lower ribs.
Keep the neck in line with the spine.
bent-over-row.mistake: Standing up into the pull to move heavier weight.

cues: Set tension before the first rep.
Lead with the elbows.
Pause briefly at the squeeze.
band-row.mistake: Letting the shoulders roll forward on the return.
